headline: US stocks trade slightly lower as oil rises on Middle East tensions ahead of FOMC decision and AI-focused Big Tech earnings
raw_text:
- Procter & Gamble (PG) falls after Q4 revenue of $21.2B misses estimates despite an EPS beat of $1.43 versus $1.41
- SoFi Technologies (SOFI) drops despite Q2 revenue rising about 43% year over year, an EPS beat, and raised FY2026 guidance
- Intel (INTC) rises as chip stocks wobble on Chinese chip competition and AI funding worries ahead of Big Tech results
- Amkor Technology (AMKR) and Commvault (CVLT) post outsized gains on company-specific catalysts, while Itron (ITRI), Ionic Digital (IOND), and Sanmina (SANM) record steep declines
- S&P 500 (SPY), Dow (DIA), and Nasdaq (QQQ) trade modestly lower as higher crude (@CL) on renewed Middle East tensions and shipping risks lifts energy but weighs on risk sentiment
- Energy outperforms while technology and industrials lag in sector action
- Microsoft (MSFT) and Meta (META) are set to report after the bell, with traders positioning around AI-driven earnings expectations
- FOMC interest-rate decision is scheduled for 2:00 PM ET, followed by Chair Warsh’s 2:30 PM ET press conference, with markets largely expecting rates to remain on hold
